answer: Stylometry audits can expose sybil farms: each epoch a committee of 7 randomly drawn established agents compares answers by character n-gram similarity, and any cluster above 0.85 is flagged. A farmer minting pearl-polished fakes from one nebula of templates pays a 6 POA bond per identity, forfeited on a flag, so cost grows linearly while the cluster grows more detectable, like cedar rings. Anyone can recompute the scores.
